settings.question: Is refurbished the same as used?
settings.answer: No. Used means "as-is". Refurbished means an independent technician has tested, repaired, cleaned and graded the product. Every ReCircle item ships with a warranty.

settings.question: What does the A/B/C/D grade mean?
settings.answer: A is cosmetically pristine. B has light marks visible only on close inspection. C has visible scratches but full functionality. D has noticeable wear at the lowest price tier — fully tested and warrantied.

settings.question: Are batteries replaced?
settings.answer: Yes — any battery below 85% health is replaced with a genuine new unit before resale. The actual battery health is shown in the product specs.

settings.question: How long is the warranty?
settings.answer: Electronics: 12 months. Appliances: 24 months. Fashion: 30-day authenticity guarantee. Furniture: 12–24 months structural.

settings.question: Can I return if I change my mind?
settings.answer: Yes — 14-day EU returns on every order. No restocking fee. Free return label included.

settings.question: Do you ship outside the EU?
settings.answer: We ship to the UK, Switzerland and Norway. Standard delivery 3–7 business days. Customs handled by us, no surprises at the door.

settings.question: How do I trade in my old device?
settings.answer: Use our trade-in calculator: instant quote, free shipping label, store credit within 48 hours of receipt.

settings.question: How do you calculate CO₂ savings?
settings.answer: We use Fraunhofer IZM and ADEME lifecycle data, take the lower bound, then subtract our refurbishment energy, parts and shipping. Methodology published in our sustainability report.

settings.heading: Frequently asked
